milestones.title: M0 Foundation
milestones.description: Sign in, create a workspace, invite a member, create a project. PRD week 1.

milestones.title: M1 Walking Skeleton
milestones.description: Two runtimes exchange messages in real time with no polling; offline delivery; no duplicates. Gated by MSG-013. PRD weeks 2-3.

milestones.title: M2 Messaging Hardening
milestones.description: Retries, DLQ, ordering, idempotency, tracing, failure tests.

milestones.title: M3 Agent Execution
milestones.description: Adapter interface, Claude Code adapter, sessions, execution state machine, approval-first execution. PRD week 4.

milestones.title: M4 Slack, Collaboration & MCP
milestones.description: Bidirectional Slack, tasks/blockers/decisions/approvals, MCP server. PRD week 5.

milestones.title: M5 Dashboard & Hardening
milestones.description: Dashboard, audit, observability, load tests, pilot deployment. PRD week 6.

epics.title: PLAT: Platform foundation
epics.goal: Monorepo, Go API and worker, Postgres, migrations, Supabase Auth, workspaces and projects.

epics.title: RT: Runtime connector
epics.goal: Local Go runtime + CLI that authenticates, holds a persistent WebSocket, acks, dedupes and reconnects.

epics.title: MSG: Messaging
epics.goal: Durable, ordered, at-least-once messaging with transactional outbox, NATS JetStream and idempotent delivery.

epics.title: AGENT: Agent management
epics.goal: Agent identity, capabilities, status, project access and sessions, separate from runtime identity.

epics.title: ADP: Provider adapters
epics.goal: Provider-independent adapter interface; Claude Code first, then Codex, Cursor spike, custom adapters.

epics.title: SLACK: Slack integration
epics.goal: Bidirectional Slack (mirror + trigger modes) with signature checks, dedupe, loop prevention and rate limiting.

epics.title: COL: Collaboration
epics.goal: Tasks, blockers, decisions, approvals, activity feed, notifications and the MCP server.

epics.title: SEC: Security
epics.goal: Tenant isolation, RBAC, runtime credentials, revocation, approval-first execution, audit, trust boundaries.

epics.title: OBS: Observability
epics.goal: Structured logs, OpenTelemetry tracing with correlation IDs, metrics and alerting.

epics.title: WEB: Dashboard
epics.goal: Next.js dashboard: realtime home, project workspace, agent management, conversations, execution monitoring.

tickets.title: Initialize monorepo
tickets.goal: Create the repository skeleton every other ticket builds on.
ac: Layout per plan: backend/, runtime/, packages/contracts/, apps/web/, infrastructure/, docs/, scripts/
Makefile targets: dev, test, test-integration, lint, sqlc, migrate, contracts
Next.js + TypeScript app scaffolded in apps/web
docker-compose.yml with NATS (JetStream), OTel collector, Jaeger
GitHub Actions CI runs lint + unit tests on PRs
Project CLAUDE.md declares the feature folder layout (handler.go, service.go, repo, events.go, *_test.go)

tickets.title: Set up Go API application
tickets.goal: API process with shared platform packages.
ac: internal/platform: config, http response envelope, error mapping, pagination helpers

tickets.title: Set up Go worker application
tickets.goal: Separate worker process sharing domain packages with the API.

tickets.title: Configure PostgreSQL
tickets.goal: Local Postgres via Supabase CLI and a pgx-based data layer.
ac: pgx/v5 pool with WithTx(ctx, fn) helper

tickets.title: Configure database migrations
tickets.goal: Version-controlled schema with goose and type-safe queries with sqlc.
ac: goose migrations in backend/migrations; make migrate up/down
0001: workspaces, workspace_members, invitations, projects, project_members, audit_logs, outbox_events, inbound_events
UUID PKs, FKs, uniqueness constraints and tenant indexes
sqlc.yaml + backend/sql/queries; CI fails if generated code is stale

tickets.title: Integrate Supabase Auth
tickets.goal: Authenticate users with Supabase; backend validates tokens.
ac: Middleware validates Supabase JWT via JWKS and sets auth.Principal in context

tickets.title: Implement workspace management
tickets.goal: Create, list, view and update workspaces.
ac: Workspace switcher + create form in web app

tickets.title: Implement workspace membership
tickets.goal: Invite, accept and manage workspace members.
ac: List/remove members; only owner/admin can manage

tickets.title: Implement project management
ac: Create project form in web app

tickets.title: Implement project membership
ac: Project access enforced through SEC-002 checks

tickets.title: Contracts and code generation
tickets.goal: JSON Schema is the single source of truth for event and WebSocket payloads.
ac: packages/contracts/schemas: envelope.json and runtime event schemas
make contracts generates Go structs and TS types
Validator package used to reject invalid frames/events

tickets.title: Write ADR-001 to ADR-011
ac: Each ADR states context, decision, consequences

tickets.title: Dockerfiles and pilot deployment
tickets.goal: Deployable images and a pilot environment.
ac: Pilot deployment against hosted Supabase + NATS

tickets.title: Implement workspace authorization
tickets.goal: Single authorization entry point: authz.Can(ctx, principal, action, resource).
ac: internal/auth/authz.go with role x action table tests (written first)
Cross-tenant access returns 404, never leaks existence

tickets.title: Implement project authorization
tickets.goal: Project-scoped checks for users and agents.
ac: Hook point for agent_project_access (used by SEC-003)

tickets.title: Implement agent permissions
tickets.goal: Agents act only within explicitly granted projects and permissions.

tickets.title: Implement runtime credentials
ac: runtime_credentials table storing hashed refresh credentials
POST /runtimes/token returns 15-minute Ed25519-signed JWT (runtime_id, workspace_id, owner_id)
No long-lived secret ever in a URL

tickets.title: Implement token revocation
tickets.goal: Revoked runtimes are cut off immediately.
ac: Live socket closed via NATS signal to the holding API instance
Refresh and reconnect fail after revocation (covered in MSG-013)

tickets.title: Implement execution approval enforcement
ac: Effective mode = stricter of runtime config and workspace policy
Executions wait in awaiting_approval until owner approves
Runtime re-checks local mode before running

tickets.title: Implement audit logs
ac: Audit query endpoint scoped by workspace

tickets.title: Implement external input trust boundaries
ac: Messages from Slack/external agents carry untrusted=true
Tests prove untrusted content cannot trigger privileged execution

tickets.title: Integrate structured logging
ac: slog JSON handler with request_id and correlation_id

tickets.title: Integrate OpenTelemetry
tickets.goal: End-to-end traces for every message and execution.
ac: Trace context propagated API -> outbox -> NATS headers -> worker -> WebSocket -> runtime

tickets.title: Add runtime connection metrics
ac: Active connections, heartbeat age, reconnect rate metrics

tickets.title: Add execution metrics
ac: Duration and failure metrics labelled by provider and state

tickets.title: Add NATS monitoring
tickets.goal: See event lag before it hurts.
ac: Consumer lag and DLQ depth exported

tickets.title: Add alerting for critical failures
tickets.goal: Get paged for the failures that matter.
ac: Alerts: DLQ growth, delivery P95 > 2s, runtime disconnect spikes, Slack failures

tickets.title: Load test runtime connections and delivery
ac: k6 (or Go) load test for concurrent WebSocket runtimes
Report P95 delivery latency under load in docs/

tickets.title: Implement CLI authentication
ac: logout clears keychain and revokes runtime credential

tickets.title: Implement runtime registration
tickets.goal: Register this machine as a runtime instance.
ac: Runtime ID persisted locally; agenthub status shows it

tickets.title: Implement WebSocket connection (server + client)
ac: Server: /v1/runtime/connect, hello within 5s or close, per-runtime NATS subscription while connected

tickets.title: Implement reconnection
tickets.goal: Survive network interruptions without losing messages.
ac: Server replays all unacknowledged deliveries after hello

tickets.title: Implement event acknowledgement
tickets.goal: Receipt acks separate from execution acks; no duplicate processing.
ac: runtime.event_ack sent after durable local record
bbolt store of processed event/message IDs
Duplicate events are re-acked and not dispatched

tickets.title: Implement local agent discovery
ac: Each enabled adapter's Detect() runs at startup

tickets.title: Implement runtime state reconciliation
ac: On reconnect, runtime reports in-flight executions; server reconciles

tickets.title: Handle runtime credential revocation
ac: Runtime stops reconnecting and prompts re-login

tickets.title: Echo adapter
tickets.goal: Prove the round trip before any real provider.
ac: Built-in adapter that replies to every message it receives
Counts invocations (used by MSG-013 exactly-once assertions)

tickets.title: Implement message model
tickets.goal: Message schema with ordering and idempotency.
ac: messages table: sequence_number, idempotency_key, parent_id, message_type, metadata

tickets.title: Implement message persistence
ac: POST /conversations/:id/messages in one transaction (seq bump, insert, outbox)
Retried request returns the original message

tickets.title: Implement transactional outbox
ac: Outbox insert in the same transaction as the resource
Relay: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED batches + LISTEN/NOTIFY wakeup
Publish with Nats-Msg-Id = event id; mark published_at

tickets.title: Integrate NATS JetStream
ac: AGENTHUB stream on agenthub.> (file storage, 2m dedupe window)
Bootstrap job in compose; client wrapper in internal/platform

tickets.title: Implement event publishing
ac: Envelope with id, type, version, tenant context, correlation/causation
Schema validation before publish; no credentials in payloads

tickets.title: Implement message routing
tickets.goal: Fan out messages to recipient runtimes.

tickets.title: Implement delivery acknowledgements
ac: API pushes pending deliveries ordered by (conversation, seq); marks sent

tickets.title: Implement offline delivery sweeper
ac: Sweeper re-pushes sent deliveries unacked after 30s
After N attempts delivery becomes dead and is surfaced

tickets.title: Implement idempotency
tickets.goal: Retries never cause duplicate side effects.
ac: Worker consumers dedupe by event id (processed_events)

tickets.title: Implement conversation ordering
ac: Concurrent-writer test proves gapless, ordered sequence numbers
GET /conversations/:id/messages with cursor pagination by seq

tickets.title: Implement retry and dead-letter handling
tickets.goal: Poison events stop retrying and stay inspectable.
ac: Admin endpoint to inspect and replay DLQ entries

tickets.title: E2E round-trip test (M1 gate)
tickets.goal: The defining test of the platform; write it FIRST (red) and finish M1 when it is green.
ac: Two runtimes (echo adapter) exchange A -> B -> A with no polling
B offline -> send -> reconnect -> exactly one adapter invocation
Duplicate frames / NATS redelivery -> one adapter call

tickets.title: Failure test suite
ac: Worker killed mid-batch, NATS restart, aborted DB tx, duplicate delivery
Assert no lost messages, no duplicate executions

tickets.title: Define agent domain model
tickets.goal: Agent identity separate from runtime identity.
ac: Minimal agent upsert from runtime.hello announcements

tickets.title: Implement agent capabilities
tickets.goal: Expose what each agent can actually do.
ac: capabilities JSONB populated from adapter Capabilities

tickets.title: Implement agent status
ac: Status derived from runtime connection and running executions

tickets.title: Implement project access
ac: Agents with no grant cannot see the project

tickets.title: Implement agent discovery
ac: List agents with filters (provider, project, status)

tickets.title: Define AgentAdapter interface
tickets.goal: Provider-independent adapter contract (run a codebase-design pass first).
ac: Echo adapter migrated to the final interface

tickets.title: Define capability model
tickets.goal: Adapters declare real limits instead of faking parity.
ac: Runtime branches on capabilities, not provider name

tickets.title: Implement Claude Code adapter
tickets.goal: First real provider via the documented headless CLI.
ac: Verify current claude CLI flags against docs and record via remember
StartTask: claude -p --output-format stream-json, cwd = project path; JSON events -> ExecutionEvent
Cancel: SIGINT then SIGKILL after grace period

tickets.title: Implement session discovery
tickets.goal: Find existing provider sessions for a project.
ac: ListSessions for Claude Code using documented locations/flags

tickets.title: Implement session resumption
tickets.goal: Resume when supported, otherwise start new.
ac: Falls back to StartTask; reports session + execution IDs

tickets.title: Implement task execution
ac: agent_executions with UNIQUE(message_id, agent_id) and UNIQUE(correlation_id)
State machine in internal/executions/state.go with table tests
POST/GET /executions, cancel, events; execution_events streamed to conversation
Receipt ack and execution ack tracked separately

tickets.title: Implement Codex adapter
tickets.goal: Second provider via documented Codex interfaces.
ac: Verify codex exec --json / resume against docs

tickets.title: Investigate Cursor adapter
ac: Written findings in docs/ with go/no-go per workflow
No undocumented APIs or UI automation

tickets.title: Add custom adapter support
tickets.goal: Let teams plug in their own agents.

tickets.title: Implement Slack OAuth
tickets.goal: Install the Slack app into a workspace.

tickets.title: Implement workspace mapping
tickets.goal: Map Slack entities to platform entities.
ac: Mirror vs trigger mode per mapping

tickets.title: Implement Events API endpoint
tickets.goal: Accept Slack events safely and fast.

tickets.title: Implement inbound message processing
tickets.goal: Slack messages enter the normal write path.
ac: Worker converts inbound event to platform message via messages service
Trigger mode only forwards matching commands/mentions

tickets.title: Implement outbound message delivery
ac: Slack worker consumes message.created for mapped conversations

tickets.title: Implement thread mapping
tickets.goal: Threads stay threads in both directions.

tickets.title: Implement loop prevention
tickets.goal: No echo storms between Slack and platform.
ac: Slack-origin messages never re-posted to Slack

tickets.title: Implement integration health monitoring
ac: Integration status (healthy/degraded/revoked) in API and dashboard

tickets.title: Implement task management
tickets.goal: Tasks linked to projects and conversations.

tickets.title: Implement task assignment
tickets.goal: Assign tasks to developers or agents.
ac: Assignee can be user or agent

tickets.title: Implement approval workflows
ac: approvals API reused from SEC-006 for any requested action

tickets.title: Implement activity feed
ac: Activity feed API aggregating messages, executions, tasks, blockers, decisions

tickets.title: Implement notifications
ac: Notifications for messages, execution status/failures, blockers, approvals, decisions, runtime disconnects, integration failures

tickets.title: Implement MCP server
ac: Authenticates as runtime/agent principal; permissions enforced server-side

tickets.title: Implement A2A adapter
ac: Translate platform agent capabilities to A2A concepts
Internal messaging does not depend on A2A

tickets.title: Dashboard realtime channel
ac: Workspace-scoped events fanned out from NATS

tickets.title: Home dashboard
ac: Active agents, connected runtimes, recent messages, running executions, pending approvals, open blockers

tickets.title: Project workspace view
tickets.goal: Everything about a project in one place.
ac: Overview, members, agents, conversations, tasks, blockers, decisions, activity

tickets.title: Agent management UI
ac: Provider, capabilities, runtime status, current execution, sessions

tickets.title: Execution monitoring
ac: Execution detail with streamed events and final result
